newsitem.title: USA: TheraTx has no information from HCFA.
newsitem.headline: TheraTx has no information from HCFA.

text.p: TheraTx Inc said Thursday it has received no recent information from the Health Care Financing Administration regarding Medicare reimbursement for physical, occupational and speech therapy services.

In response to a number of recent inquiries from the investment community on the issue of salary equivalency, chief executive John A. Bardis stated, "We have received no new information from HCFA regarding reimbursement rates or implementation dates for salary equivalency. We continue to believe that HCFA is on track to disseminate proposed rules for salary equivalency sometime this fall."

Noting TheraTx's stock has declined about four points in the past 30 days, Bardis explained there has been speculation that plans to impose salary equivalency would have a long-term negative impact on the company.
Its stock was at 13-1/8, up 1/4, in late morning trading.
He told Reuters the salary equivalency proposals talk about caps on the hourly amount to be paid for in-home therapists.
For TheraTx holders, he said, the problem is "concern of the unknown." -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710
